'''Stanisław Gomułka''' (10 September 1940 – 18 July 2026) was a Polish-born economist.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Zapotoczny |first=Marcin |date=21 July 2026 |title=Nie żyje Stanisław Gomułka, profesor związany z ziemią jędrzejowską - Telewizja ITV Jędrzejów |url=https://itvjedrzejow.pl/index.php/2026/07/21/nie-zyje-stanislaw-gomulka-profesor-zwiazany-z-ziemia-jedrzejowska/ |access-date=22 July 2026 |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

== Life and career ==
From 1970 up to 2005 a reader in Economics at the [[London School of Economics]], a visiting professor or research fellow at several US universities (Pennsylvania, Stanford, Columbia and Harvard), also at Aarhus university, Netherlands Institute for Advanced Studies and the [[Central European University|Central European university]], in the years 1989-2002 advisor to the [[Ministry of Finance (Poland)|Ministry of Finance]] and [[National Bank of Poland]], from 2013 a member of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite news |title=Gomułka Stanisław - BCC |url=https://www.bcc.org.pl/strefa_eksperta/kontakty-do-ekspertow/gomulka-stanislaw/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260306214156/https://www.bcc.org.pl/strefa_eksperta/kontakty-do-ekspertow/gomulka-stanislaw/ |archive-date=6 March 2026 |access-date=22 July 2026 |work=BCC |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

His research interests were in the fields of [[endogenous growth theory|endogenous economic growth]]; economics of technological change; comparative [[economic system]]s; [[Reform movement|reforms]] and [[Post-communism|post-communist transition]], especially Poland and the former [[USSR]]; [[trade]] and financial relations between East and West; [[privatisation]] and analysis of the behaviour of enterprises in [[Central Europe]], the former USSR and China.<ref>{{Cite journal |date=September 1956|title=Rocznik Polskiego Towarzystwa Naukowego na Obczyźnie (London), rok 1954–55 |url=https://doi.org/10.2307/2269137 |journal=Polskie Towarzystwo Naukowe Na Obczyźnie |volume= |issue=3 |pages=125 |doi=10.2307/2269137 |jstor=2269137 |issn=0022-4812|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Piotr |date=22 July 2026 |title=Zmarł profesor Stanisław Gomułka |url=https://www.bcc.org.pl/zmarl-profesor-stanislaw-gomulka/ |access-date=22 July 2026 |website=BCC |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

Gomułka died on 18 July 2026, at the age of 85.<ref>[https://itvjedrzejow.pl/index.php/2026/07/21/nie-zyje-stanislaw-gomulka-profesor-zwiazany-z-ziemia-jedrzejowska/ Nie żyje Stanisław Gomułka, profesor związany z ziemią jędrzejowską] {{in lang|pl}}</ref>

== Honours and awards ==
In 2014, he received Officer's Cross of the [[Order of Polonia Restituta]].<ref>M.P. z 2014 r. poz. 923</ref>
